# Setup

```{r packages}
source(here::here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(ChIPseeker)

library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)

```

---

# Fase 1 — Importação e Estruturação

```{r import-data}
# Homologous CRE pairs from ENCODE (hg38–mm10)
homologous_cres <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "hg38-mm10-Homologous.tsv"),
  col_names = c("human_enhancer", "mouse_enhancer"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Human CREs (GRCh38)
cres_human <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "GRCh38-cCREs.bed"),
  col_names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "id_dhs", "id_ccre", "type"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_human"))

# Mouse CREs (mm10)
cres_mouse <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "mm10-cCREs.bed"),
  col_names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "id_dhs", "id_ccre", "type"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_mouse"))
```

```{r classify-match-type}
# Count how many mouse CREs each human CRE maps to (and vice versa)
human_counts <- homologous_cres %>%
  count(human_enhancer, name = "n_mouse_per_human")

mouse_counts <- homologous_cres %>%
  count(mouse_enhancer, name = "n_human_per_mouse")

# Full join: preserves orphan CREs on both sides
cres_annotated <- homologous_cres %>%
  left_join(human_counts, by = "human_enhancer") %>%
  left_join(mouse_counts, by = "mouse_enhancer") %>%
  full_join(cres_human, by = join_by(human_enhancer == id_ccre_human)) %>%
  full_join(cres_mouse, by = join_by(mouse_enhancer == id_ccre_mouse)) %>%
  mutate(
    is_homologous = !is.na(human_enhancer) & !is.na(mouse_enhancer),
    match_type = case_when(
      is.na(human_enhancer)                            ~ "mouse_only",
      is.na(mouse_enhancer)                            ~ "human_only",
      n_mouse_per_human == 1 & n_human_per_mouse == 1  ~ "1:1",
      n_mouse_per_human >  1 & n_human_per_mouse == 1  ~ "N:1",
      n_mouse_per_human == 1 & n_human_per_mouse >  1  ~ "1:N",
      TRUE                                             ~ "N:M"
    )
  )

# Separate tables
cres_homologous <- cres_annotated %>% filter(is_homologous)
cres_human_only <- cres_annotated %>% filter(match_type == "human_only")
cres_mouse_only <- cres_annotated %>% filter(match_type == "mouse_only")
```

```{r summary-phase1}
cres_annotated %>%
  count(match_type) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

---

# Fase 2 — Anotação de Genes Associados (Humano)

```{r import-gene-annotation}
# Human CRE–gene associations (pre-computed by ENCODE, closest protein-coding gene)
genes_cres_human <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "GRCh38-Closest-Genes-PC.tsv"),
  col_names = c(
    "chrom_cre", "start_cre", "end_cre", "id_dhs", "id_ccre", "type_cre",
    "chrom_gene", "start_gene", "end_gene", "transcript_id",
    "score_gene", "strand_gene", "gene_id"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r biomart-hgnc}
# Strip Ensembl version suffix (e.g. ENSG00000186092.7 → ENSG00000186092)
ensembl_ids <- genes_cres_human$gene_id %>%
  unique() %>%
  sub("\\..*", "", .)

# Download HGNC symbols from Ensembl
mart <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

gene_names <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
  filters    = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values     = ensembl_ids,
  mart       = mart
)

# Join HGNC symbols to gene table
genes_cres_human <- genes_cres_human %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)) %>%
  left_join(gene_names, by = c("gene_id_clean" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  select(-gene_id_clean)
```

```{r join-genes-to-cres}
# Annotate cres_annotated with human gene info (one gene per CRE)
cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    genes_cres_human %>%
      dplyr::select(id_ccre, gene_id, hgnc_symbol, gene_biotype,
                    transcript_id, chrom_gene, start_gene, end_gene, strand_gene) %>%
      distinct(id_ccre, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("human_enhancer" = "id_ccre")
  )
```

---

# Fase 3 — Extração de Sequências

```{r extract-sequences}
# Filter homologous CREs with valid coordinates in both species
cres_to_align <- cres_annotated %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is_homologous,
    !is.na(chrom_human), !is.na(start_human), !is.na(end_human),
    !is.na(chrom_mouse), !is.na(start_mouse), !is.na(end_mouse)
  )

# --- Human GRanges ---
gr_human <- GRanges(
  seqnames = cres_to_align$chrom_human,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = cres_to_align$start_human, end = cres_to_align$end_human)
)
seqlevels(gr_human) <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
seqinfo(gr_human)   <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

# --- Mouse GRanges ---
gr_mouse <- GRanges(
  seqnames = cres_to_align$chrom_mouse,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = cres_to_align$start_mouse, end = cres_to_align$end_mouse)
)
seqlevels(gr_mouse) <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
seqinfo(gr_mouse)   <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

# --- Extract sequences ---
seq_human <- getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, gr_human)
seq_mouse <- getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, gr_mouse)

# Add to dataframe
cres_to_align <- cres_to_align %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sequence_human = as.character(seq_human),
    sequence_mouse = as.character(seq_mouse)
  )
```

```{r sequence-summary}
cat("CRE pairs with sequences:", nrow(cres_to_align), "\n")
cat("Mean human CRE length:", round(mean(nchar(cres_to_align$sequence_human))), "bp\n")
cat("Mean mouse CRE length:", round(mean(nchar(cres_to_align$sequence_mouse))), "bp\n")
```

---

# Fase 4 — Alinhamento e Identidade de Sequência

Local alignment (Smith-Waterman), gap opening = -2, gap extension = -1.

```{r alignment}
aln_full <- pairwiseAlignment(
  DNAStringSet(cres_to_align$sequence_human),
  DNAStringSet(cres_to_align$sequence_mouse),
  type         = "local",
  gapOpening   = -2,
  gapExtension = -1
)

cres_to_align <- cres_to_align %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cre_identity_pct = pid(aln_full, type = "PID1"),
    cre_align_score  = score(aln_full),
    cre_align_length = nchar(alignedPattern(aln_full))
  )
```

```{r alignment-summary}
summary(cres_to_align$cre_identity_pct)

cat("\n% identity > 80%:", round(mean(cres_to_align$cre_identity_pct > 80) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("% identity > 70%:", round(mean(cres_to_align$cre_identity_pct > 70) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("% identity > 60%:", round(mean(cres_to_align$cre_identity_pct > 60) * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

---

# Fase 5 — Exportação

```{r export}
# Merge alignment results back into cres_annotated
cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    cres_to_align %>%
      dplyr::select(human_enhancer, mouse_enhancer,
                    sequence_human, sequence_mouse,
                    cre_identity_pct, cre_align_score, cre_align_length),
    by = c("human_enhancer", "mouse_enhancer")
  )
```
